00059    template<size_t size> static void swap(void *buffer)
00060    {
00061       unsigned char *head = static_cast<unsigned char *>(buffer);
00062       unsigned char *tail = head + size - 1;
00063       while(head < tail)
00064       {
00065          unsigned char temp = *head;
00066          *head++ = *tail;
00067          *tail-- = temp;
00068       }
00069    }
